exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Address Translation Traversal
exploitedBy.relevance: Attackers can traverse NAT boundaries to reach management plane interfaces that should be restricted.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Hide Infrastructure
exploitedBy.relevance: Adversaries may hide infrastructure used to bypass management plane ingress controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Protocol Tunneling
exploitedBy.relevance: Telemetry egress paths can be abused to tunnel exfiltrated data out of the network disguised as legitimate monitoring traffic.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Indicator Blocking
exploitedBy.relevance: Blocking telemetry indicators on egress paths prevents detection of exfiltration activity.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Valid Accounts
exploitedBy.relevance: Shared credentials across zones allow adversaries to use the same valid account to move between security boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Credential Stuffing
exploitedBy.relevance: Shared credentials increase the risk of credential stuffing attacks succeeding across multiple zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Software Deployment Tools
exploitedBy.relevance: Monitoring agents deployed via software deployment tools can be abused as a lateral movement vector across network zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
exploitedBy.relevance: Vulnerabilities in monitoring agent remote services can be exploited to move laterally between zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: An unsegmented management VLAN allows adversaries to sniff sensitive management traffic across the broadcast domain.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Boundary Bridging
exploitedBy.relevance: Lack of VLAN segmentation enables bridging between management and other network boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Trust Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Orchestration controllers can be abused to modify trust relationships and propagate elevated trust across zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Vulnerability Scanning
exploitedBy.relevance: Exposed health check endpoints can be discovered and scanned by adversaries to identify vulnerabilities across zone boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
exploitedBy.relevance: Health check endpoints may reveal network configuration and zone topology information to adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Traffic Duplication
exploitedBy.relevance: Blind spots at zone boundaries may allow traffic duplication and exfiltration without detection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Non-Application Layer Protocol
exploitedBy.relevance: Unmonitored out-of-band channels often use non-application layer protocols that bypass standard monitoring controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Traffic Signaling
exploitedBy.relevance: Adversaries may use traffic signaling over out-of-band channels to covertly communicate without triggering monitored paths.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Subvert Trust Controls
exploitedBy.relevance: Supply chain implants in monitoring agents subvert trust controls to appear as legitimate signed software.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Internal Proxy
exploitedBy.relevance: An overpermissive service mesh sidecar can act as an internal proxy enabling unauthorized traffic routing within the management zone.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify System Firewall
exploitedBy.relevance: Stale firewall rules effectively modify firewall policy to permit legacy access that should be blocked.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify Network Device Firewall
exploitedBy.relevance: Legacy management access permitted by stale rules on network device firewalls exposes management interfaces to unauthorized access.
